---
description: Check for conflicts before implementing a requested change
---

Before implementing the requested change, perform this check and
report the result before proceeding:

1. Which authority document(s) currently govern this concept?
2. Does the requested change contradict any of them?
3. Does the requested change contradict any entry in
   `/05-governance/decision-log.md`?
4. Which layer (per the hierarchy) does this change belong to, and
   does a higher layer already constrain it?
5. What escalation level (A/B/C) does this change require?

If any conflict is found, stop here and present it — do not proceed
to implementation in the same turn. If no conflict is found, state
that explicitly ("No conflicts found against [list of files checked]")
and then proceed.
